identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Repair terminal closeout and safe-prune recovery for closed issues

values.goal: Make typed C-SDLC v2 closeout and prune recovery complete, evidence-preserving, deterministic, and usable across already-closed v0.91.8 issues.
values.required_outcome: The typed closeout surface reconciles causally valid terminal head drift, safely cleans only proved generated state, reports legal repair actions for earlier lifecycle phases, and enables every eligible closed worktree to prune.
declared_scope: Typed dirty-worktree classification and safe cleanup before prune
v0.91.8 closeout recovery evidence and sweep report
authority_boundary: Issue #5710 owns only its issue-local records, declared C-SDLC v2 closeout sources/tests, and closeout recovery proof packet
The existing validate-prune and receipt-backed prune operations remain final removal gates
No unrelated issue lifecycle record may be changed during implementation validation
operator_constraints: No force prune or destructive manual cleanup
No manual card or .csdlc state editing
Publish only after exact-head subagent review and focused validation
